consequence.statement: New gRPC healthcheck support is added; nothing in the evidence says existing setups break.

original.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 adds support for gRPC healthchecks.

decision.reason: [ev-9e92c97ef99e] lists this under "Enhancements" as new support for gRPC healthchecks. Nothing in it describes a changed default, a removal, a rejection or a failure for existing configurations. If an operator does nothing, nothing changes, so "none" (informational) is the right consequence. Confidence is low because the changelog line says only that support was added; it doesn't say outright that existing healthchecks are unaffected.
